description: This PHP class defines a log request handler for the openXDeliveryLog plugin in Revive Adserver. It manages bucket data for ad request logging, including retrieving dependencies, bucket table name, columns, statistics table name, and migration mapping.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogRequest_LogRequest
classes.description: A class handling log request data for openXDeliveryLog plugin, managing bucket and statistics table info and data migration mapping.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for the log request.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns the columns and their types in the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping for migrating bucket data into statistics.
